title: CRISPR screens for host factors critical for infection by SARS-CoV-2 variants of concern
model: Calu-3 cells, Brunello genome-wide knockout library, SARS-CoV-2 WT/Alpha/Beta survival selection
contrast: Infected (WT+Alpha+Beta) vs uninfected (5 vs 2); also Alpha vs uninfected (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: ACE2 and GATA6 as top proviral factors; KREMEN2/SETDB1 Alpha-specific
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 (shallow depth, pooled viruses inflate dispersion); ACE2 #2, GATA6 #9 by enrichment
verdict: BARCS ranks the paper's two headline genes ACE2 (#2) and GATA6 (#9) at the top of the enrichment list, but shallow sequencing and pooling three viruses leave nothing at FDR 0.10 and the rest of the list uncorrelated (rho 0.34).
